# sonarqube_portfolio (Resource)

A portfolio. Requires Enterprise edition or above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Portfolios require the Enterprise edition or higher.
resource "sonarqube_portfolio" "payments" {
  key            = "payments"
  name           = "Payments"
  description    = "Every project tagged payments."
  selection_mode = "TAGS"
  tags           = ["payments"]
}

# A portfolio of portfolios and application branches.
resource "sonarqube_portfolio" "company" {
  key          = "company"
  name         = "Company"
  portfolios   = [sonarqube_portfolio.payments.key]
  applications = [sonarqube_application.shop.key]
  application_branches = {
    (sonarqube_application.shop.key) = [sonarqube_application_branch.release.name]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Portfolio key.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `application_branches` (Map of Set of String) Branches selected for applications of the portfolio, by application key. An application added to a portfolio starts with its main branch. Listed applications get exactly these branches (name the main branch too to keep it); applications not listed keep their selection. Needs `applications`.
- `applications` (Set of String) Keys of applications in the portfolio.
- `branch` (String) Branch to select, for TAGS, REGEXP and REST modes. Defaults to main branches.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `portfolios` (Set of String) Keys of other portfolios included in this one as sub-portfolios. They are references: each stays a portfolio of its own. SonarQube rejects cycles. When omitted, sub-portfolios are not managed.
- `regexp` (String) Regular expression on project keys, for REGEXP mode.
- `selected_projects` (Attributes Set) Projects, for MANUAL mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--selected_projects))
- `selection_mode` (String) How projects are selected: `NONE`, `MANUAL`, `TAGS`, `REGEXP` or `REST` (all remaining projects).
- `tags` (List of String) Tags, for TAGS mode.
- `visibility` (String) `public` or `private`; changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.
- `qualifier` (String) `VW`.

<a id="nestedatt--selected_projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selected_projects`

Required:

- `project_key` (String) Key of a project to include in the portfolio.

Optional:

- `selected_branches` (Set of String) Branches. When omitted, the main branch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_portfolio.example 'payments'
```
